entities.name: Sacrifice at Koilos
entities.description: An event with significant effects on Dominaria's history in which Xantcha and Ratepe died to let Urza kill Gix.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who built the screaming spiders and killed Gix.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Urza's "brother" who sacrificed herself to stop Gix.

entities.name: Ratepe
entities.description: Urza's friend who sacrificed himself to stop Gix.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor who kept a lair in Pincar City and was killed by Urza.

entities.name: Screaming spiders
entities.description: Artifacts that kill Phyrexians while leaving non-Phyrexians unharmed.

entities.name: Festival of Fruits
entities.description: Festival during which the screaming spiders were set off.

entities.name: Pincar City
entities.description: City in Efuan Pincar where Gix kept his lair.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: Place across the sea where Gix and Urza fought in a cave.

entities.name: Powerstones
entities.description: Urza's stones whose power Gix negated.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Invading force from which Dominaria had to survive.

entities.name: War with Phyrexia
entities.description: War Urza resolved to take the lead in.

events.summary: For a year Xantcha and Ratepe help Urza create screaming spiders; on the Festival of Fruits they are set off across Dominaria, including Gix's lair in Pincar City.
events.quote: these artifacts were set off across Dominaria, including in Pincar City

events.summary: After a short fight with Urza, Gix escapes Efuan Pincar and travels to Koilos; Urza, Xantcha and Ratepe follow.
events.quote: Gix escaped Efuan Pincar and traveled across the sea to Koilos

events.summary: In the cave Gix gains the upper hand by negating the power in Urza's powerstones.
events.quote: Gix started gaining the upper hand in the battle by negating the power in Urza's powerstones

events.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe reach into the beam, breaking Gix's concentration and restoring Urza's powerstones, but the beam kills them.
events.quote: Together, they reached into the beam that disrupted Urza's powers, breaking Gix's concentration

events.summary: Their sacrifice lets Urza kill the praetor, leaving him the only survivor.
events.quote: their sacrifice gave Urza the chance to kill the praetor

events.summary: Grieving, Urza resolves to take the lead in the War with Phyrexia rather than react to it.
events.quote: Urza resolved to no longer be reactive to the Phyrexian threat

relations.note: Enabled by Xantcha and Ratepe's sacrifice
